info.title: Properties API
info.description: Public properties and foreclosure listings API

get.description: Returns a paginated list of public, live properties (listings and foreclosures). Use `polymorphic_type=listing` or `polymorphic_type=foreclosure` to restrict to a single type. Supports `page` and `page_size` (default 100, max 300).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number within the paginated result set.

parameters.name: polymorphic_type
parameters.description: Restrict results to a single property type.

parameters.name: listing_types
parameters.description: Filter by multiple listing types. Comma-separated.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Filter by specific property IDs. Multiple values may be separated by commas.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of center point. Use with `lng` and `radius_km`.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of center point. Use with `lat` and `radius_km`.

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Search radius in kilometers. Use with `lat` and `lng`.

parameters.name: polygon
parameters.description: Comma-separated `lng lat` pairs forming a closed polygon.

post.summary: List points of interest near a coordinate
post.description: Returns nearby points of interest (POIs) for an arbitrary latitude/longitude pair, using the same selection logic as the Marketability Report neighbourhood section: up to 16 POIs, at most 3 per place type, with per-category search radii (airport 10 km; metro, tram, train and future metro 2 km; everything else 1 km), ordered nearest-first. Although the operation is a read with no side effects, coordinates are passed in a JSON request body, so the endpoint uses POST. The route requires the trailing slash — a redirected slashless POST can drop its body in some clients.

200.description: Points of interest near the queried coordinate, ordered nearest-first. An empty array means nothing is within range — not an error.

400.description: Missing `latitude`/`longitude`, out-of-range value, or non-numeric value.

distance.description: Distance from the queried point, in metres, rounded to 2 decimals.
